messages:
maya: quick sync idea 1: add a 'snap anchor' to the timepicker so you can mark an event (deploy, launch) and quickly compare that exact window across days. thinking: small vertical marker on heatmap + session-scoped anchors.

leo: user goals? ad-hoc debug vs saved comparisons?

maya: both. primary is regression detection around events. secondary is sharing the exact comparison window with teammates.

sam: perf note 1: sampling causes p95 jitter. we use per-bucket reservoir sampling now, so anchor-aligned buckets need either aligned boundaries or a sampled badge. recommend a tiny "sampled" pill with hover showing sample_rate.

tia: a11y nits: anchor creation must be keyboard accessible. announce via aria-live: Anchor created: <label>. Marker color must meet 4.5:1 contrast.

aria: copy proposal: button label "Create anchor"; tooltip "Anchor this time window for quick comparison". anchor marker text: "Anchor 025-03-05 14:20 UTC". shareable deep link if user clicks save. mock: https://figma.com/s/snap-anchor (WIP).

leo: default sampling should be adaptive for hosted. enterprise gets explicit full-scan option with cost warning. add in-dashboard callout: "Results may be sampled. Click to see sample rate and full-scan."

sam: engineering: we'll add sampling_rate and sampling_strategy to the metrics and an API flag anchor_mode=stream|full. streaming deltas keeps UI snappy; full is slower.

ux-bot: A11Y checklist:

• Anchor creation reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space).
• Anchor creation announced via aria-live.
• Marker color >= 4.5:1 contrast.
• Sampled badge has tooltip explaining bias.
• Focus order: timepicker -> anchor list -> heatmap.

maya: plan: aria + color tokens from tia and final mocks from aria by EOD tomorrow; sam to confirm API flag and telemetry scope by EOD. schedule 20m review Wed 10am. thanks all :heart:

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: many)
